scope: Ag phase-change transport on a QSGS Ag/Ti3SiC2 bicontinuous geometry; continuum model, not atomistic MD

geometry.geometry_definition: QSGS binary morphology already stored in repository; do not regenerate for this handoff
geometry.ag_connectivity_source: Native binary Ag mask is the complement of qsgs_morphology.npz:skeleton. qsgs_component_coarsegrain.py partitions native Ag into six-face-connected nodes and only links real Ag shared faces. This graph is currently validated for the two-temperature solver, not wired into the single-temperature CLI.

initial_state.single_temperature_initialization: Start independently from uniform 300 K; do not import any two-temperature checkpoint.

thermal_model.temperature_field: one local temperature T and one total lattice enthalpy field H

phase_change.liquid_fraction_rule: At Tm, f_l=(h-h_s(Tm))/L_f clipped to [0,1]; below the latent plateau f_l=0, above it f_l=1 and liquid sensible heat raises T. Volumetric implementation weights by Ag fraction and fixed solid reference density.
phase_change.volume_change_on_melting: not modeled; solid reference density is fixed

heat_source.profile: Q=I0/l_skin * exp(-r^2/R^2) * exp(-d/l_skin) * S(t), applied only to Ag; d is depth below z top
heat_source.time_profile: rectangular step: source on for heat-ps, then off for cool-ps
heat_source.masking: Ag phase fraction in the projected prototype; exact binary-QSGS integration is available in qsgs_source_integration.py but not exposed in the current single-temperature CLI

measured_integrated_powers.method: exact analytic integral over binary Ag voxels and conservative aggregation
measured_integrated_powers.status: validated for separate two-temperature full-domain run; must be reconnected and revalidated for single-temperature production

boundary_conditions.z: insulated at both outer faces in current single-temperature solver
boundary_conditions.case_A: Adiabatic scaffold limit: Ti3SiC2 contributes no heat capacity or conductivity; only Ag heat conduction is represented through the projected field. Not a measured interface condition.
boundary_conditions.case_B: Ideal thermal contact limit: shared local temperature and volume-weighted Ag/Ti3SiC2 heat capacity/conductivity, with zero added interface resistance. Not a measured interface condition.

current_prototype_gaps: CLI exposes only 5A/10A projected cells and Cases A/B; no native graph or tile_xy option.
CLI has no bottom heat sink, explicit timestep, or spatial field snapshot option.
Current CLI samples the source at thermal-cell centers and multiplies by Ag fraction; it does not call the exact binary geometry source integrator.
5A and 10A projected-cell solutions have not passed spatial convergence for local melt-pool claims.
The continuous solver does not model melt flow, free-surface deformation, atomistic fixed/Newton/sputter/evaporation layers, or grain structure.
